source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The banner CSS removes its align-items: flex-start override. The actual consumer is a toolbarbutton; PanelUI sets its localized label and notificationid before showing it. Update icons retain their16px dimensions, trailing order and centered background image. This verifies the scoped override removal and consumer, not a measured layout or accessibility result.
title: AppMenu update banners stop forcing flex-start alignment
